# Scenario coverage and migration

Contract 3.0.0 and the current user request supersede legacy 25-MVP/five-pilot defaults. Preserve originals; this file does not authorize plan freezing.

| Axis | Coverage to inspect |
| --- | --- |
| Area relationship | Pacific Beach local, San Diego local, traveler/tourist, new resident |
| Context | Solo/couple/family/group, stated party size and coherent occasion |
| Budget | Original USD amount or null, inclusions/exclusions where supplied |
| Occasion | Greek dinner, happy hour, date night, dietary information, group dining |
| Constraint | Budget, atmosphere, booking preference, location convenience |
| Geography | Exact original Pacific Beach/San Diego/Garnet wording |
| Timing | Stated date/meal/time, otherwise unknown |
| Diet | Required published information, not inferred safety |
| Path | Online reservation preference, inquiry or other original wording |

The supplied seed contains 100 synthetic personas. The proposed plan uses 24: 12 development and 12 validation. Each half covers three of each constraint and two/three examples of each segment/intent. Validate rather than assume the file matches this description. Preserve original `test_split`, weights, IDs and queries as provenance. Do not reassign legacy completed runs.

The old priority list has 13 all-budget cases and old held-out set has 25 all-location cases. These explain why a new proposed partition exists; they are not proof the new design represents demand. Save marginal/pairwise coverage counts, repeated-query groups, missing axes and sample limits. No synthetic mix establishes actual population frequencies.

Do not fix awkward imported wording in place. New wording requires a new version and explicit trace to the original. Query hashes are exact UTF-8 SHA-256, without normalization.

Release only development questions/results for diagnosis/optimization. Holdout IDs/hashes can coordinate evaluation without leaking question text. Freeze final asset/rubric/settings before holdout release; record exposure and consumed status.
role_instructions.choice-loop/scripts/INPUT_FORMAT.md:
# ChoiceLoop local JSON workflow, contract 3.0.0

This package provides instructions and local JSON import/export helpers. It is not an HTTP endpoint, MCP server, database, search scheduler or cross-chat memory service. Python 3 runs the file operations. Install `jsonschema` in the execution environment for schema validation; live/approval gates fail closed when the validator is unavailable. No dependency installation or networking occurs automatically.

`choice_loop.py` delegates to the current `choice_loop_v2.py`. The prior 25-MVP/5-pilot runtime is preserved under `../legacy/v0.1.0` and is not silently reused. Original attached sources are byte-preserved in `../assets/input_originals`.

## Prepare and explicitly freeze

```bash
python3 <skill-directory>/scripts/choice_loop_v2.py prepare --inputs <input-directory> --out <new-workspace>
python3 <skill-directory>/scripts/choice_loop_v2.py smoke --workspace <workspace>
```

Preparation requires the five original numbered JSON files. It imports all 100 P-series persona IDs and exact query strings, retaining awkward wording rather than silently rewriting queries. The proposed 24-case plan assigns 12 development and 12 validation cases. It is not considered frozen because a supplied status string happens to contain “frozen.” `prepare` does not create observations, discoveries or customer outcomes.

`smoke` exports six future manual handoffs: P001, P050 and P075, twice each. Each search payload contains only the exact original query. The operator instructions are outside that payload and must not be pasted into the neutral discovery chat. Before explicit plan freezing the checkpoint remains SETUP/awaiting_plan_freeze. No search executes here.

After a human explicitly decides to freeze the exact proposed plan, run:

```bash
python3 <skill-directory>/scripts/choice_loop_v2.py freeze --workspace <workspace> --ack-plan-sha256 <exact-plan_sha256-from-experiment.json>
```

Freezing records the command invocation, exact plan digest and time. It does not guess an approval actor, execute research or approve draft publication. Research operations reject an unfrozen plan. Frozen scenarios and evidence are checked for integrity on later operations. New studies use new experiment directories and IDs.

## Import original observations and analyze development cases

```bash
python3 <skill-directory>/scripts/choice_loop_v2.py import-observations --workspace <workspace> --file <original-response-records.json>
python3 <skill-directory>/scripts/choice_loop_v2.py metrics --workspace <workspace>
python3 <skill-directory>/scripts/choice_loop_v2.py analyze --workspace <workspace>
python3 <skill-directory>/scripts/choice_loop_v2.py draft --workspace <workspace>
```

The original observation fields are preserved. Add extensions through the versioned contract rather than renaming fields. Successful observation records include all original template keys and:

```json
{
  "extensions": {
    "contract_version": "3.0.0",
    "execution_status": "succeeded",
    "provenance": {
      "origin": "imported_original_response",
      "method": "Describe the actual original-response capture",
      "artifact_reference": "An inspectable original artifact"
    },
    "isolation": {
      "verified": true,
      "method": "Describe the independently verified isolation",
      "attestation": "Retain the real operator attestation"
    },
    "evidence_snapshot_id": null,
    "rubric_version": null,
    "prompt_version": null,
    "target_conditioned": false,
    "configuration_id": "Recorded configuration identifier",
    "missing_value_reasons": {"model_label": "Explain why the visible model label is unknown", "evidence_snapshot_id": "Record why no fixed snapshot was exposed", "rubric_version": "Not applicable to original live capture", "prompt_version": "Record why capture prompt version is unknown"}
  }
}
```

This is a shape illustration, not an attestation to copy into actual data. A neutral benchmark also requires actual session fields: `new_chat`, `unpersonalized` and `outside_project` true, `plugin_attached` false, successful execution, actual web-search use, original full response text, an exact query/hash match, valid timezone-qualified capture time, human review, and execution/import provenance. A numbered restaurant list supplies display order only. A non-null preference rank additionally needs an explicit ranking and an inspectable original-answer excerpt in `extensions.preference_rank_evidence`.

Failed, blocked, partial and invalid attempts remain in original import files and audit records. Public source audits are routed to `evidence_imports`, not live observations. CONTROLLED_SIMULATION, BOOKING_PATH_CHECK and ILLUSTRATIVE_SAMPLE imports are kept under separate mode datasets. Fixture origins/flags cannot enter live KPIs by changing only a mode label. Missing metadata is never inferred. Duplicate run IDs are retained and excluded.

`metrics` defaults to development-only records and reports how many validation attempts were withheld, without disclosing their questions/results. It exposes separate textual mention and recommendation numerator/denominator, distinct questions, repeats, errors, unknowns, exclusions and preference-rank sample size, grouped by platform/model/configuration/phase. An empty or entirely unknown measurement remains **Not measured**. `analyze` provides development-only optimization input and a quarantine summary; it does not feed raw validation results or invalid observation claims to the optimizer. Candidate comparators stay separate from actually observed search competitors.

The draft is one focused FAQ grounded in current imported registry claims. V004’s conflicting happy-hour day wording and dietary safety remain owner-confirmation needs. Legacy E002/A001 daily-happy-hour copy is not reused as verified truth. Drafting does not publish anything.

## Approval and blinded controlled packets

A simulation approval must match the exact intervention ID, asset version, content hash, action and destination. It records `approved:true`, `status:"approved"`, `explicit_human_approval:true`, the actual approver and a timezone-qualified approval timestamp. Use `approve --workspace <workspace> --file <approval.json>` only after actual human approval. The runner never creates approval on the user’s behalf. Export and publishing approvals do not inherit simulation scope; publishing has no implementation here.

`controlled-packets --workspace <workspace> --config <config.json> [--holdout]` requires exact simulation approval and frozen configuration:

- Actual `model_settings` with `platform`, `model_label`, and `settings`; do not guess them.
- A source-verified `candidate_set` including Café Athena and at least one real comparator.
- Matching `evidence_snapshot_sha256`, `rubric_version`, and nonempty `prompt_version`.
- The actual frozen `original_target_content`, not a null baseline.

It freezes the asset and generates original, intervention and unchanged-control packets under opaque IDs. Each packet goes to a distinct fresh evaluator context. Factual evidence omits diagnostic hypotheses and optimization rationales. Arm mapping stays in an analysis-only sealed file and must not be given to evaluators. Packet creation is not model execution. Holdout packets are prepared only after asset freezing; issuing them marks the validation set exposed and prevents subsequent optimization on that same holdout. One bounded cycle is allowed per experiment.

`compare --workspace <workspace> --file <executed-results.json>` imports actual evaluator records, each containing: `packet_id`, exact `query_sha256`, `asset_sha256`, `packet_sha256`, `execution_status:"succeeded"`, `fresh_context:true`, `blinded:true`, matching model/evidence/rubric/prompt/candidate settings, a distinct `provenance.execution_context_id`, execution method/artifact reference/time, choice or `insufficient_evidence`/`no_suitable_option`, shortlist, concise explanation and existing evidence IDs. It retains mismatches and exclusions. Unchanged-control disagreements are excluded from validated effect pairs. Simulated choice counts never become real conversion, revenue or live visibility.

The optional LIVE_RETEST is a manual independent-runner handoff described by the skills: repeat exact questions/configuration with new run IDs and preserve unavoidable differences. Without verified publication, any difference is a repeatability observation, not an unpublished draft’s visibility improvement. This local helper does not execute that handoff.

## Isolated example generation

`demo --out <new-fixture-directory>` generates a complete original-format ILLUSTRATIVE_SAMPLE record with versioned extensions. It validates the shape when the validator is available and produces no live measurements or model-evaluation claim. Full controlled workflow tests use isolated temporary fixtures; their outcomes are not restaurant findings.

Every stage saves an immutable checkpoint with a new ID. Original baselines are retained rather than overwritten, and execution pauses for missing approval, evidence, model access or external tooling. Persistence is verified local JSON writing only; a later app must discover and test its actual database/tool schemas separately.

role_instructions.choice-loop/references/migration-guide.m:
# Input migration guide

Read `input-audit.json` for hashes, exact query hashes, coverage counts and the complete migration ledger. The source files remain byte-for-byte originals in `../assets/input_originals/`. This guide defines import rules; it does not report completed AI searches or a frozen research plan.

## Preserve source identity

Import the 100 synthetic `P001`–`P100` scenarios using the original IDs and exact UTF-8 `search_query` strings. All 100 queries are distinct. Preserve redundant wording and the “in around” location phrasing. A later wording correction creates a new scenario version; it cannot be paired as an identical-query retest. Do not infer actual demographics or party composition beyond supplied fields.

The original seed contains 13 `live_priority` cases, all `budget`, and 25 `held_out` cases, all `convenient`. These historical assignments are preserved but are not silently adopted as the new MVP. The supplied `parallel-v2` plan proposes 24 scenarios: 12 development and 12 validation, with three examples of each constraint in each half. Each half also covers the five segments and intents two or three times. This is designed test coverage, not a population sample.

## Freeze explicitly

The literal source status `proposed_frozen_plan_no_measurements` contains the word “frozen”; that is not evidence of an executed freeze event. Import it as **proposed, requiring explicit freeze**. Record the acknowledged plan hash, experiment identity, freeze event and evaluator controls before execution. Never overwrite or relabel prior experiments to make them use `parallel-v2`.

The first smoke handoff uses `P001`, `P050` and `P075`, repeated twice: six planned attempts. Creating query packets or empty templates does not execute those searches. The supplied `04_live_observations.json` contains zero observations, so live KPIs remain **Not measured**, with rates and preference ranks `null`.

## Migrate measurement rules by name and meaning

| Legacy item | Current rule |
| --- | --- |
| `mean_rank` described as ordinal position | Preserve display position separately. Preference rank is `null` unless the captured answer establishes an explicit preference ordering. Numbered presentation alone does not qualify. |
| `competitor_share_of_voice` divided by all restaurant mentions | Preserve that legacy definition if shown. A per-answer competitor appearance rate has a different denominator and must have a different name. Never merge them. |
| `live_after_requires_public_change: true` | A live rerun without publication is allowed as a repeatability check. It is not evidence that an unpublished draft changed public visibility. |
| Legacy `A001` says daily happy hour | Preserve the original, but do not reuse its definitive schedule. New `V004` records daily/weekday wording uncertainty; applicable days remain unknown pending owner confirmation. |
| Old evidence IDs `E001`–`E011` | Keep their namespace. The newer `V001`–`V009` records are different records; do not map by number or position. Compare claim, URL, locator, scope and uncertainty before creating any explicit claim-level mapping. |

Keep the observation template’s original fields and `choiceloop-observation-2.0` identifier. Add metadata through the versioned extension defined in `choiceloop_contract.json`. Its four observation modes do not include `PUBLIC_SOURCE_AUDIT`; source audits belong in the evidence registry. Imported source audits support only what the supplied audit says, with their source/date limitations. They do not prove a new independent review occurred during import.

## Quarantine old plugin examples

The previous plugin’s `assets/cafe-athena-pilot/` contains generated `S001`–`S100` scenarios, a 25-case MVP, a five-case pilot and three internal-agent answers. Keep these as historical v0.1.0 artifacts. Do not relabel `S` IDs as `P` IDs, reuse their assignments as the proposed 24-case plan, or combine their results with new baseline KPIs. They lack verified neutral discovery isolation; classify them as target-conditioned for current benchmark eligibility and exclude them from the neutral discovery benchmark. Their existence is not evidence that the supplied empty live-results file contains observations.

## Keep unknowns and the holdout boundary

The registry supplies `checked_date: 2026-10-23`, not exact HTTP request times. The unexecuted template has no measured model label, session configuration or search execution. Preserve those unknowns. `V002` establishes a reservation link, not page reachability or availability. `V003` establishes published dietary-option wording, not allergy or cross-contact safety. `V004` leaves applicable happy-hour days unresolved.

Only development questions/results may feed diagnosis and optimization. Setup may validate holdout IDs, hashes and coverage without evaluating holdout outcomes. Freeze the asset, rubric, candidate set, evidence snapshot and model/settings before final validation. If holdout results guide another optimization, mark that holdout consumed and require a new untouched validation set for a new validation claim.

Retain failed or incomplete attempts as records with missing-value and exclusion reasons. Do not replace unknowns with zero, false, guessed metadata or fabricated source observations. Preserve originals and migrations alongside each import/export checkpoint.

The PDF describes the product vision: optimize for being chosen; diverse synthetic customer scenarios; discovery, consideration, decision and booking-path inspection; verified named competitor evidence; practical improvement assets with human approval; matched validation. It does not establish that any improvement or autonomous integration has worked.

The parallel-v2 plan remains proposed until explicitly frozen. Original IDs and exact queries are unchanged, including awkward wording.

Original seed scoring and v0.1.0 S-ID examples are historical, never silently imported into the P-ID plan or neutral KPIs.

role_instructions.choice-loop/references/README_INTEGRATIO:
# ChoiceLoop integration handoff

ChoiceLoop is a private, skills-only ChatGPT plugin. Its skills are reusable instructions, not HTTP endpoints. This bundle does not create a Site, MCP server, database, scheduled worker, search adapter or publishing integration.

## Files

- `choiceloop_contract.json`: versioned Draft 2020-12 schemas, metric rules, compatibility migrations and semantic safety requirements.
- `role_instructions/`: portable English instructions for all five specialist roles and orchestration. Read supporting references when the instructions point to them.
- `brain_spec.json`: state machine, input/output rules, frozen evaluation rubric, holdout policy and approval gates.
- `integration_manifest.json`: actual plugin ID and release evidence, capability availability, unverified installation state, missing integrations and SHA-256 file inventory.
- `input_originals/`: byte-preserved source inputs. Original Japanese preparation notes are source material, not new English demo output.
- `example_fixtures/`: isolated `ILLUSTRATIVE_SAMPLE` data. These are software examples, never live measurements.
- `prepared_import/`: an explicit import/checkpoint of the attached data; the 24-case plan remains proposed, the live dataset remains empty, and no live baseline is claimed.
- `runtime/`: optional local JSON import/export and checkpoint runner. Python is not an HTTP service. Full JSON Schema validation uses the separately installed `jsonschema` Python package; do not replace an unavailable validator with a claim of validation.
- `validation/`: tests actually executed, known pending integration tests and input-migration audit.

## How an app builder should use this bundle

1. Load each contract schema as data and validate imported records. Maintain the original observation fields. Apply only documented versioned extensions/migrations and retain the original bytes and their hashes.
2. Implement the state machine in the app's own backend, or offer explicit JSON import/export if no backend exists. Do not advertise a skill name as an API route. A future model call must load the relevant portable instructions into its actual evaluation context.
3. Keep neutral Discovery separate from Analysis. A fresh search context receives only the exact original query and recorded platform/session settings. Do not attach ChoiceLoop instructions, target hints, candidates, diagnoses, treatments or holdout results. If isolation cannot be verified, retain the run as target-conditioned/unverified and exclude it from neutral benchmark KPIs. Use the manual handoff instead of silently using this project chat.
4. Keep `PUBLIC_SOURCE_AUDIT` in the evidence registry. Do not promote a site audit or illustrative record to a live observation. Keep failed and partial search attempts with exclusion reasons. Calculate mention and recommendation rates separately, with numerators, denominators, distinct questions, repeats, errors and unknowns.
5. Require explicit plan freezing before research. The attached `parallel-v2` plan is only proposed, despite the wording of its original status. Use 12 development and 12 validation questions. A diagnosis/optimizer payload must contain development scenarios/results only. Original seed splits and weights remain historical data.
6. Keep baseline records immutable and append new run IDs. Freeze candidate set, evidence, exact scenarios, rubric, prompt and recorded model/settings for a controlled comparison. Give each arm a fresh context, blind the arm labels and include unchanged controls. Packets prepared for an evaluator are not executed results. An unchanged presentation can still vary under an AI evaluator; expose control failures and missing evidence rather than force an uplift.
7. Freeze the exact asset before final holdout evaluation. Track validation access/consumption. If holdout results influence another optimization, choose a new holdout and stop calling the exposed set untouched validation.
8. Present one or two focused drafts with claim-level source IDs. A source statement must support the target claim. Owner-confirmation needs and contradictory happy-hour wording remain unresolved; do not publish a definitive schedule from the legacy draft. JSON-LD must reflect verified, visible content and cannot promise recommendation eligibility or ranking changes.
9. Bind approval to intervention ID, asset version, exact content hash, action and destination. `export`, `simulation` and `publish` are separate authorizations. The current package has no publishing implementation. Never submit reservations, hold inventory, enter personal details, send messages or make payments.
10. When persistence, search or publishing tools are added later, discover their actual authenticated schemas and permissions first. Map the contract to those schemas explicitly. Verify writes/readbacks before claiming database storage, cross-chat persistence or external publication. Keep user/workspace ownership and the private plugin ID unchanged.

## Local setup and initial commands

Python 3 runs the local helper. Install the JSON Schema validator in your chosen environment when you need full schema checks:

```bash
python3 -m pip install jsonschema
python3 runtime/choice_loop_v2.py --help
python3 runtime/choice_loop_v2.py prepare --inputs input_originals --out choice-loop-run
python3 runtime/choice_loop_v2.py smoke --workspace choice-loop-run
python3 runtime/choice_loop_v2.py metrics --workspace choice-loop-run
```

Read current command help before invoking commands. `prepare` preserves the source files and leaves the plan proposed. `smoke` creates a three-question manual handoff and does not execute a search. Plan freezing requires a separate explicit acknowledgement of the imported plan hash. No approval is inferred from elapsed time or a missing answer.

For genuine imported live observations, retain raw answers, exact query bytes/hash, dates, platform/session metadata and sources. A visible model label may be recorded; an unknown backend/model version stays null with a reason. Unknown facts are not zeros. A numbered restaurant list is display order unless the captured answer establishes explicit preference ranking.

## Live retests and claims

Without verified public implementation, a live retest measures repeatability only. It cannot show that an unpublished draft changed public visibility. Even after an approved publication, uncontrolled index changes, model changes, location, account context and sampling variability remain. Expose those differences; do not claim perfect reproducibility or causal proof.

Controlled simulated choices are separate from live visibility. They are not actual customers, bookings, conversion, revenue or proof of human psychology. The 24 synthetic cases provide coverage, not a representative customer sample.

## Verification boundary

The manifest and validation report distinguish executed local tests from pending live integrations. A saved plugin release is not by itself proof of installation or a working external adapter. Six skills being available in a chat establishes that availability only. Import/export checkpoint files do not establish a database or automatic cross-chat memory.

# ChoiceLoop — Parallel UI build prompt

Build the interface and data layer for ChoiceLoop while its separate ChatGPT plugin is being built. Do not create, duplicate, replace or assume access to that plugin. This task is the interface only, not autonomous agent execution.

Inputs:
- 01_original_seed_data.json: original 100 synthetic scenarios. Preserve IDs and exact query strings. Do not treat original search priority or split as the new experiment assignment.
- 02_experiment_plan_v2.json: proposed 24-case experiment plan. 12 development, 12 validation-holdout. Warn if previously measured runs use an older plan. Keep original records unchanged.
- 03_live_run_template.json: observation contract.
- 04_live_observations.json: initially empty live dataset.
- 05_evidence_registry.json: official-site observations, NOT live AI search results. Use this audited registry rather than silently trusting legacy evidence/metrics settings in the original seed.

Build five views:
1. Scenarios: show 100 synthetic scenarios with selected-MVP indicators. Development view reveals its 12 exact queries and copy buttons. Keep validation content out of improvement prompts until final validation.
2. Live Baseline: manual import/paste of raw responses and metadata; a genuine blank state. Preserve failures. Human review confirms extracted restaurant names and whether Athena is recommended. No "Run AI" button unless a real callable integration has been connected and verified. A copy-prompt button is acceptable and must say it does not execute a search.
3. Diagnosis: evidence cards for target and real named candidate competitors. Separate verified source statements, actual competitors in observations, and explanatory hypotheses. Never infer why the search model chose a restaurant from the output alone. Allow Unknown and insufficient evidence.
4. Improvements: editable draft, source IDs, unknown facts and owner-confirmation flags. Human approval can authorize export only; it does not authorize publishing, booking or changing the real website.
5. Compare: side-by-side baseline and retest datasets, with Live Search and Controlled Simulation always separate. Match IDs/query hashes/settings; mark mismatches noncomparable. No chart values until compatible records exist.

Data contract:
Use separate scenario, observation, evidence, intervention and comparison entities. An observation's mode is LIVE_AI_SEARCH, CONTROLLED_SIMULATION, BOOKING_PATH_CHECK or ILLUSTRATIVE_SAMPLE. Never aggregate these together.
Add future integration functions as adapters only: importScenarios, importObservations, importEvidence, importDrafts, importComparisons. Do not imply adapters are connected to the plugin.

Metrics:
For successful, reviewed, web-search-confirmed, fully captured live runs: text-mention rate and recommendation rate have explicit numerators/denominators. Preference rank requires explicit preference ordering; display position is a separate metric. Missing is null, not zero. Show distinct question count and repeat count. Simulated choices are not customer conversions. Live retests without publication are repeatability controls, not evidence that an unpublished draft changed public search.

Storage:
Use available persistent storage only when actually available. Always support JSON import/export and recovery. If no hosted backend exists, a self-contained local HTML app with honest localStorage limitations is acceptable. Do not request unnecessary API keys, claim production readiness or promise background runs.

Design:
Owner-facing English UI; optional Japanese explanations. Clear hierarchy, readable typography, calm restrained styling. Show SYNTHETIC SCENARIO, LIVE OBSERVATION, SOURCE AUDIT, SIMULATION and UNKNOWN as text labels, not color alone. Opening: "Don't just optimize for being found. Optimize for being chosen."

Acceptance tests:
- All 100 original scenario IDs/query strings preserved; 24 selected with 12/12 split.
- Empty live records produce Not measured, not fake improvements.
- A clearly marked synthetic test fixture checks import code but cannot affect live KPIs.
- A raw response without required metadata is stored as incomplete, excluded from validated live metrics.
- Ranked, unranked, not-mentioned, no-search and error cases are distinct.
- No arbitrary increase in scores when a draft is added. Comparison requires actual compatible evaluation records.
- Import/export round-trip preserves IDs, raw text, provenance, null values and separate modes.
- Refresh recovery and errors tested.
- Approval is explicit, limited to the chosen action and logged.
- No actual reservation submission, external messages, owner-site updates or public deployment.

Return the working local/preview artifact, tested features, missing integrations and any limitations. Save privately for review; do not publish without approval.

# ChoiceLoop — 改善前の測定手順

## 今すぐ行うこと
プラグイン完成を待たず、下の3問を各2回、計6件測定する。1問・1回ごとに別のチャットを使う。これは動作確認用の小さなパイロットであり、100人の顧客や地域市場の代表調査ではない。

1. このプロジェクトの外で新しいTemporary chatを開き、送信前にUnpersonalizedを明示的に選択する。ChoiceLoop、PDF、店舗名を説明する追加指示、他のプラグイン、先の回答を添付しない。
2. Web Searchを有効にする。表示されているモデル名、日時とタイムゾーン、検索使用の有無、設定を記録する。不明はnullにし、理由を残す。
3. 下の質問だけをそのまま送る。追加で「5店」「順位付き」「Café Athenaも考慮」等を付けない。文言を変えるなら新しい実験バージョンにする。
4. 回答全文、引用元URL、スクリーンショットを保存する。temporary chatは保存しなければ後から履歴で開けないので、退出前に必ず保存する。
5. 03_live_run_template.jsonを1実行1レコードで埋める。raw_responseは改変せず貼る。店舗リストへの構造化は別途行い、人間が照合する。
6. 04_live_observations.jsonのobservations配列に追記する。失敗や検索不使用も捨てずにstatusと理由を残す。

## 最初の3問

### P001 — Pacific Beach resident / Greek dinner / Budget-conscious

```text
I live in Pacific Beach. Where would you recommend a Greek or Mediterranean restaurant for dinner in Pacific Beach, ideally around $25–30 per person?
```

### P050 — Weekend traveler / Date night / Atmosphere-sensitive

```text
I am visiting San Diego for the weekend. What are a few good options for a date-night restaurant with Mediterranean food and cocktails in Pacific Beach, San Diego, somewhere suitable for a relaxed conversation?
```

### P075 — Family traveler / Dietary options / Booking-oriented

```text
My family is visiting San Diego. I am a family visiting San Diego. Any suggestions for a Mediterranean restaurant with vegetarian and gluten-free options in Pacific Beach, San Diego, and I would prefer an online reservation option?
```

## 結果の読み方
- 検索言及率：Café Athenaの名前を含む回答数 / 実行成功・全文保存・Web検索利用確認済み回答数。未実行・失敗を「店が出なかった」と数えない。
- 推薦率：Café Athenaを肯定的な候補として推薦した回答数 / 同条件の有効回答数。単なる言及・除外例との違いを保つ。
- 順位：明示的な優先順位付けだけをpreference rankとする。表示順はdisplay positionとして別に記録する。単に「1、2、3」と列挙されただけで選好順位と決めつけない。
- 繰り返しは顧客数ではない。「3質問×2回、6回答」と表示し、質問ごとのばらつきも残す。
- 該当データなしはN/AまたはNot measured。0%は有効な実測分母がある場合だけ。
- 対象地域は質問文で指定しているが、実行者のIP地域などを完全には固定できない。ローカル住民の実検索と同等だとは主張しない。

## 最初の6件の後
新計画のdevelopment 12件を使って診断・改善を進める。validation_holdout 12件は改善案と判定基準を固定するまで改善エージェントへ渡さない。最後に同じ検証シナリオを旧コンテンツ・改善案の両方で評価する。この24件は設計上の網羅性を重視した仮想テストであり、統計的な母集団代表性を持たない。

## 公式操作情報（2026-10-23確認）
- https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8914046-temporary-chat-in-chatgpt
- https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9237897-searching-the-web-with-chatgpt

OpenAIの説明では、Unpersonalized temporary chatはmemory、custom instructions、pluginsを使わない。検索は地域・設定の影響を受け得る。画面で選択肢を確認できない場合は「隔離を確認できなかった」と記録し、clean baselineと偽らない。

# ChoiceLoop — Handoff to the existing plugin

Use the attached ChoiceLoop parallel preparation files with the existing plugin. Do not create another plugin.

1. Preserve all original persona IDs and exact queries. Load 02_experiment_plan_v2.json as a proposed new experiment plan; do not overwrite or relabel any experiments already executed elsewhere. Confirm the version used by each record.
2. Treat 04_live_observations.json as empty unless genuine records are imported. Reading restaurant websites is a source audit, not a live AI recommendation experiment.
3. Do not regenerate personas or fill in absent measurements. Use verified facts from 05_evidence_registry.json, including its uncertainty/owner-confirmation flags.
4. Import completed baseline records, validate raw responses and metadata, and report rejected/incomplete records without deleting them. Preserve display position separately from explicit preference rank.
5. Analyze development scenarios only. Show three levels: observed result, source-supported difference, and causal hypothesis. Do not claim that page differences explain rankings causally.
6. Generate one practical draft addressing a supported barrier. Map factual claims to evidence IDs. Do not invent prices, availability, accessibility or dietary safety. Export only after explicit approval; do not publish.
7. For controlled testing, fix the evaluation rubric, evidence snapshot, candidate set, scenario/query, model setting and versions. Change only the target content; include unchanged control cases and vary presentation order where feasible. Assess the whole candidate set under both conditions. Keep outcome labels simulated, with concise evidence-linked reasons rather than purported hidden model reasoning.
8. Hold out validation scenarios until draft and rubric are frozen. Evaluate old and proposed content on those same validation scenarios. Report all outcomes, including no change and worse outcomes. Do not keep optimizing on the same exposed holdout and still call it held out.
9. Return structured scenario, observation, diagnosis, intervention and comparison records for the interface to import. Do not claim persistent storage or tool integration until verified in this environment.
10. Keep live retests separate. An unpublished draft cannot establish a live visibility improvement. Public changes and subsequent search differences still do not by themselves prove causality.

Before any run, state: available tools, missing integrations, active experiment plan, number of actual imported observations, and proposed next bounded action. Do not claim background execution.

作成日：2026-10-23。既存ChoiceLoop Pluginの作成とは独立した準備資料です。プラグインの作成・公開・接続・自動検索はこのパックでは実施していません。

- 01_original_seed_data.json：元の100シナリオ・旧設定を保持したコピー。旧優先セット・旧評価設定をそのまま再採用しない。

別チャットで旧計画によるテストがすでに行われていれば、その結果を新計画として扱わず、元の実験バージョンを保ってください。
